items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: No, once in a while Manuel would take me on a job, or Buddy Petit -- and gave me two dollars.

ctx.x: Did you go by yourself or did you take...

Oh, I'd go with my brother or my sisters, or some of my cousins. When the Catholics gave a dance, the whole family would go. Papa never really was in for anything like that. Neither was my mother, because my mother was sick most all her life. But they wasn't people that went out at night like that. Now, when they had dances at Bernard Hall, we used to kind of slip in there. We wasn't allowed in there, you see. But we'd ease in there. But Manuel would get me in there, or sometimes Fritz, or...
